There will be a sole row of images on the wall at any time.

The idea is to ignore counting the images that don't line up starting from the left.
Any excess would be added to the next column because they're put in the same file. 
So, if the current lines up, add it to the file, otherwise, move to the next file.

The idea here is to make sure that the number in each cell is equal (=<) to the required value,
 and that the number of 1s in that specific cell and the number of 1s in the right one are equal (=)
and that A doesn't exceed the number of files. If it does, we make sure that you add all the numbers and the number of files still equals the sum of all 1s in that row.
Also add the excess left over to the next column. Repeat this process until all excesses are accounted for
